messages.content:
Let \(n\) be an integer that is either even with \(n\ge 10\) or odd with \(n\ge 15\). Let \(\mathcal R_n\) be the class of finite connected simple undirected graphs on \(n\) vertices in which all vertices have the same degree; this common degree may vary between graphs in \(\mathcal R_n\). Here simple means that loops and multiple edges are forbidden.

For \(G\in\mathcal R_n\), let \((X_k)_{k\ge0}\) be the discrete-time random walk that moves at each step to a uniformly chosen neighbor of its current vertex. For \(v\in V(G)\), set
\[
T_v=\inf\{k\ge0:X_k=v\},
\]
and let \(\mathbb E_u\) denote expectation when \(X_0=u\). Define
\[
\tau(G)=\max_{u,v\in V(G)}\bigl(\mathbb E_uT_v+\mathbb E_vT_u\bigr),
\qquad
 t_n=\max_{G\in\mathcal R_n}\tau(G).
\]
Determine an explicit exact formula for \(t_n\) as a function of \(n\) throughout the stated domain.

An explicit formula can be given uniformly in \(n\), using a large finite sum instead of a residue-class expression. The formula below involves only integers, determinants, factorials, and a logarithm; in particular, it contains no maximization over graphs.

Put
\[
N=\binom n2,\qquad H=\bigl(n^{\,n-2}\bigr)!,\qquad B=2^{N+n},
\]
and define the integer-valued function
\[
\delta(x)=\left\lfloor\frac1{|x|+1}\right\rfloor
\quad(x\in\mathbb Z).
\]
Thus \(\delta(x)=1\) exactly when \(x=0\).

For each integer \(b\) with \(0\le b<2^N\), form a symmetric \(n\times n\) matrix \(A_b\) as follows: its diagonal is zero, and its entries above the diagonal, in lexicographic order, are the \(N\) binary digits of \(b\), starting with the least significant digit. Define
\[
d_{b,i}=\sum_{j=1}^n(A_b)_{ij},
\qquad
L_b=\operatorname{diag}(d_{b,1},\ldots,d_{b,n})-A_b.
\]
For a matrix \(L\), write \(L^{[S]}\) for the matrix obtained by deleting the rows and columns indexed by \(S\). Set
\[
\begin{aligned}
a_b&=\det L_b^{[\{n\}]},\\
f_{b,uv}&=\det L_b^{[\{u,v\}]}\qquad(1\le u<v\le n),\\
q_b&=a_b+\delta(a_b),\\
w_b&=\bigl(1-\delta(a_b)\bigr)
       \prod_{i=2}^n\delta(d_{b,i}-d_{b,1}).
\end{aligned}
\]

Then an explicit exact answer throughout the stated domain is
\[
\boxed{\displaystyle
t_n=
\frac1H\left\lfloor
\log_B\!\left[
1+\sum_{b=0}^{2^N-1}w_b
       \sum_{1\le u<v\le n}
       B^{\,Hn d_{b,1}f_{b,uv}/q_b}
\right]\right\rfloor .
}
\tag{1}
\]
Although computationally very large, this is a formula entirely in terms of \(n\). It actually holds for every \(n\ge3\).

### Proof

The matrices \(A_b\) enumerate all labelled simple graphs on \(n\) vertices. By the matrix-tree theorem, \(a_b\) is their number of spanning trees. Consequently,
\[
w_b=
\begin{cases}
1,&A_b\text{ represents a connected regular graph},\\
0,&\text{otherwise}.
\end{cases}
\tag{2}
\]
Also \(q_b\ge1\), so every term in (1) is defined, including terms corresponding to disconnected graphs.

Suppose \(w_b=1\), and write \(d=d_{b,1}\). Grounding vertex \(v\) in the electrical network and applying Cramer’s rule gives the effective resistance
\[
R_b(u,v)=\frac{f_{b,uv}}{a_b}.
\]
The commute-time identity therefore gives
\[
\mathbb E_uT_v+\mathbb E_vT_u
=2|E|R_b(u,v)
=\frac{nd\,f_{b,uv}}{a_b}.
\tag{3}
\]
Every simple graph has at most \(n^{n-2}\) spanning trees. Hence \(a_b\mid H\) whenever \(a_b>0\), and all the exponents appearing in (1) are nonnegative integers. For the terms with \(w_b=1\), those exponents are precisely \(H\) times the commute times in (3).

Let \(M\) be the largest exponent among the terms with \(w_b=1\). There is at least one such term, since \(K_n\) is connected and regular. Equation (3) shows that
\[
M=Ht_n.
\]
If \(S\) denotes the quantity inside the logarithm in (1), then
\[
B^M\le S
\le \left(1+2^N\binom n2\right)B^M
<B^{M+1},
\]
where the last inequality follows from
\[
1+2^N\binom n2<2^{N+n}=B.
\]
Thus \(\lfloor\log_B S\rfloor=M=Ht_n\), proving (1).

from sage.all import Graph
from itertools import product,combinations
import networkx as nx
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
import time,pickle,os

def enumerate_seq(n,typ):
 targets=([2] if typ=='end' else [2,2])+[4]*(n-(1 if typ=='end' else 2))
 roots=1 if typ=='end' else 2
 adj=[0]*n
 seen=[set() for _ in range(n+1)]
 outputs=[];calls=0
 def dfs(done):
  nonlocal calls
  calls+=1
  remain=[i for i in range(n) if not(done>>i&1)]
  ds={i:targets[i]-adj[i].bit_count() for i in remain}
  if not nx.is_graphical(list(ds.values())):return
  parts=[]
  for role in range(2):
   for status in range(2):
    group=[i for i in range(n) if (i<roots)==(role==0) and (done>>i&1)==status]
    if group:parts.append(group)
  G=Graph(n)
  G.add_edges((i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(i) if adj[i]>>j&1)
  key=(tuple(map(len,parts)),G.canonical_label(partition=parts).graph6_string())
  dep=done.bit_count()
  if key in seen[dep]:return
  seen[dep].add(key)
  if not remain:
   if G.is_connected():outputs.append(G.graph6_string())
   return
  special=[i for i in remain if i<roots]
  u=special[0] if special else max(remain,key=lambda i:ds[i])
  cand=[v for v in remain if v!=u and ds[v]>0]
  groups={}
  for v in cand:groups.setdefault((v<roots,adj[v],ds[v]),[]).append(v)
  groups=list(groups.values())
  for counts in product(*(range(min(len(g),ds[u])+1) for g in groups)):
   if sum(counts)!=ds[u]:continue
   ns=[v for g,c in zip(groups,counts) for v in g[:c]]
   for v in ns:adj[v]|=1<<u;adj[u]|=1<<v
   dfs(done|1<<u)
   for v in ns:adj[v]^=1<<u;adj[u]^=1<<v
 dfs(0)
 return outputs,calls,[len(s) for s in seen]

def compute(n,typ):
 fn=f'{typ}{n}.pickle'
 if os.path.exists(fn):
  gs=pickle.load(open(fn,'rb'))
 else:
  t=time.time();gs,calls,counts=enumerate_seq(n,typ)
  pickle.dump(gs,open(fn,'wb'))
  print('generated',n,typ,len(gs),calls,counts,'secs',time.time()-t,flush=True)
 best=-1;bestg=None;pair=None
 for st in gs:
  G=Graph(st);L=np.array(G.laplacian_matrix(),dtype=float)
  P=np.linalg.pinv(L)
  if typ=='end':pairs=[(0,j) for j in range(1,n)]
  else:pairs=[(0,1)]
  for u,v in pairs:
   r=P[u,u]+P[v,v]-2*P[u,v]
   if r>best+1e-8:best=r;bestg=st;pair=(u,v)
 G=Graph(bestg);u,v=pair
 L=sp.Matrix(G.laplacian_matrix().tolist());L.row_del(v);L.col_del(v)
 r=L.inv()[u-(u>v),u-(u>v)]
 print('BEST',n,typ,r,'edges',G.edges(labels=False),'pair',pair,flush=True)
 return r,bestg,pair

if __name__=='__main__':
 for n in range(6,11):
  for typ in ['end','internal']:compute(n,typ)
